compute_angle_mae: compute the angular mean absolute error between predicted and target joint angles using AngleMAE
compute_angular_derivatives: compute mean angular velocity, acceleration, and jerk from predicted joint angle sequences using AnglularDerivatives
compute_per_finger_mae: compute per-finger angular mean absolute error for each finger using PerFingerAngleMAE
compute_pd_angle_mae: compute angular mean absolute error grouped by proximal-distal joint groups using PDAngleMAE
compute_landmark_distances: compute mean Euclidean distance for fingertip and landmark positions using LandmarkDistances with forward kinematics
